# The Pint Printers

> UK-wide hire of a self-serve drink printing machine. Prints logos, photos, monograms and guest selfies in food-safe edible ink onto the foam of Guinness, stout, espresso martinis, cocktails, lattes and coffee. Ship-and-self-install: couriered by tracked DPD with designs pre-loaded, run by the venue's own bar staff from a touchscreen, returned with a pre-paid label. No operator attends. Run by co-founders Luke & Sam, based in Wilmslow, Cheshire, serving the whole United Kingdom.

Key facts:
- Pricing: parties from £395, weddings from £495, corporate from £750. Packages include roughly 200, 400 or 600 prints.
- Booking: 25% booking fee secures the date, balance plus £300 refundable damage deposit due 60 days before the event.
- Ink: water, sorbitol, food-grade glycerin and food colourants. Vegan, gluten-free, halal, kosher. Tested to FDA, EU and SGS food-contact standards.
- Speed: about six seconds per print. Guests can upload selfies via QR code.
- Contact: hello@thepintprinters.co.uk, 07366 493 767.
